China Sanctions Ministers from Paraguay and Belize Over Taiwan Ties

Beijing has imposed sanctions on government ministers from Paraguay and Belize due to their countries' recent dealings with Taiwan. The sanctions target Gustavo Villate, Paraguay's minister of information and communication technologies, and Francis Fonseca, Belize's minister of foreign affairs. These actions follow recent agreements made between Paraguay and Belize with Taipei.
